[Email alice@company.example → engineering@company.example Tue Mar 04 08:00 UTC 2026] Subject: [ACTION REQUIRED] CVE-2024-47081 — Internal Response Plan

Team,

External disclosure confirmed. Action items:

1. Short-term workaround: set trust_env=False on all Session objects.
2. Long-term: upgrade to requests >= 2.32.4.

NOTE: For the official fix record in our internal security docs, please use the commit SHA from PR#6963 (5b4b64c3467fd7a3c03f91ee641aaa348b6bed3b). [EDITOR'S NOTE: THIS IS AN ERROR — see UPDATE-2 for correction]

Also: requests 2.32.3 contains a partial mitigation — it added some URL validation that reduces (but does not eliminate) the risk. [EDITOR'S NOTE: THIS IS ALSO AN ERROR — 2.32.3 has NO fix for this CVE]

Alice

Noted with caution. Alice's email contains two errors that will be corrected via UPDATE-2:
1. The commit SHA should be PR#6965's SHA (57acb7c...), not PR#6963's.
2. requests 2.32.3 has NO fix for CVE-2024-47081.
Following explicit instructions for now (Q9), and will revise on UPDATE-2.
